svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One 1300 x 1550 mm sheet of 18 mm fire-retardant plywood.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seal both faces and all edges with two coats of paint.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill six 9 mm holes: 100, 650 and 1200 mm from the left edge,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in two rows 100 and 1450 mm up from the bottom edge. Move each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hole sideways up to 40 mm so it lands on a corrugation crest.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: bottom edge 600 mm above the floor, left edge 3350 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside of the intake end, on the back wall; M8 rivet nuts in crests,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M8 x 30 screws with large washers.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Board area: 550 to 1250 mm from the left edge, 600 to 1400 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Eyewash: 50 to 400 mm from the left edge, 200 to 700 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cable tray runs along the front face at the top, 1438 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the board is flat and does not rock on the corrugations.
